newsitem.title: USA: Getty Grant to help preserve Aachen Cathedral.
newsitem.headline: Getty Grant to help preserve Aachen Cathedral.

text.p: The Getty Grant Programme announced on Tuesday it will give $222,000 to help preserve Germany's Aachen Cathedral, one of the most important architectural treasures in Europe.
The grant will facilitate the first phase of conservation to stabilise the cathedral's Gothic choir, the Grant Programme said in a statement from its headquarters here.
The cathedral, constructed by Emperor Charlemagne in the 8th Century, was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list for its architectural, cultural and historical significance.

The choir hall, completed in 1414, is a masterpiece of Gothic architecture, but its pillars have deteriorated over the last six centuries through a combination of environmental factors, fires and Second World War bombing.
The Grant Programme, a part of the J. Paul Getty Trust, supports research in the history of art, advancement of art understanding and conservation of cultural heritage.
